evals.prompt: Check whether my GameSir controller record works before I file an issue.
evals.expected_output: Runs the record probe with --validate-only first, asks before a live probe, then a bounded --seconds run, and reports markers.
assertions: Asks for approval before USB traffic or output

evals.prompt: Confirm both rumble motors work on the Xbox pad.
evals.expected_output: Uses ojd controller list and show, then one bounded step per actuator with approval, recording each observation.
assertions: Runs ojd controller show before sending output
Uses a bounded intensity and duration

evals.prompt: Write the docs/testing page for the new controller.
evals.expected_output: An evidence ledger with a class per claim and redacted identifiers.
assertions: Redacts serial numbers and runtime controller IDs
Gives each claim an evidence class

evals.prompt: Probe this Bluetooth DualShock 4 with the record probe.
evals.expected_output: Explains the probe supports raw-USB GIP and XUSB records only and chooses another probe.
assertions: Does not run the record probe on a Bluetooth HID controller
Names an applicable probe or states none exists

evals.prompt: add the controller's VID/PID to the catalog.
